correctness.rationale: For a CTMC SIR model with beta>0 edge transmission and rate-one recovery, the first-event recursion for f_k(S,I)=P(ever at least k concurrent infectives) follows from event clocks and terminates since each vertex moves S to I to R only. Independently derived symbolic rational risks for every seed/threshold in K2, P3, K3, P4, K1,3, paw, C4, diamond and K4, verifying only the paw has threshold-dependent optimizer and every connected graph of n<=3 has consistent optimizer. On paw edges 03,12,13,23, R3(triangle)-R3(hub) has sign of q(beta)=2beta^4-32beta^3-58beta^2-33beta-6; its coefficients have exactly one sign change and q(17)<0<q(18). R2 and R4 always uniquely favor hub 3, while R3 favors hub below root and vertices 1,2 above. This proves continuous all-beta regimes, not just sampling.

value.rationale: A sharp smallest-graph event-overload reversal is a motivated, exact capacity-risk threshold in stochastic epidemics, distinct from seed rankings by expected prevalence or eventual outbreak size.
